expected: Class/design has no live captain, damage, cargo or crew.
Generated vessel receives stable ship_id.
Refit/operator/crew changes append history rather than creating a new ship.
Civilian procedural design_id can be reused by several ships.
Two ships sharing design_id have distinct ship_id/history.
Individual cargo, owner, crew and damage never live in design definition.
Canonical ship names/registries cannot be procedurally duplicated.
Temporary designation is acceptable when a diegetic name cannot yet be validated.
Renaming preserves ship_id.
Traffic/mission/economy/logistics need exists before vessel generation.
Scanning does not retroactively create ships.
Role and operator constrain valid design/class.
Crew reference only guides generation.
Live manifest is generated from real staffing slots.
Vacancies remain visible and are not auto-filled.
Civilians/passengers are excluded from duty-watch allocation.
Continuous posts, day staff, relief and on-call are modeled separately.
Watch allocations sum to generated duty crew in the reference fixture.
Three-watch uses Alpha/Beta/Gamma.
Four-watch uses Alpha/Beta/Gamma/Delta.
Exact hours are individual-ship policy.
Changing pattern redistributes actual roster and can create scheduling/fatigue consequences.
Klingon/Romulan/Cardassian profiles do not claim Alpha/Beta/Gamma canon.
Unknown alien schedules use explicit GAME_ADDITION local watch model.
Operator doctrine affects reporting/readiness without personality locks.
B'rel and Hideki-class small crews may use staggered custom coverage.
Not all crew can sleep simultaneously.
Every casualty/vacancy can materially affect coverage.
Galaxy supports families/civilians/broad recreation when actual mission/population permits.
Defiant normal operations are spartan with low privacy and no family community assumption.
Named Enterprise-D venues are not automatically cloned to every Galaxy-class ship.
Intrepid profile supports holodecks/gym/mess/social life.
Voyager-specific galley, losses and relationships remain individual-ship history.
Generated Intrepid ship does not inherit USS Voyager biography.
23c and 24c staffing may differ substantially.
24c 26–35 reference is not backfilled to every Miranda.
Mission configuration changes specialists, obligations and social rhythm.
Handoff, training, recertification, maintenance, reports, medical and on-call consume time.
Player conversation cannot cancel obligations.
Protected rest cannot be silently erased.
Holodeck activity requires actual holodeck/capacity.
Lounge/common-room activity requires actual space.
Small/austere craft offer fewer leisure choices.
A character cannot be simultaneously on duty and in private activity elsewhere.
Travel and handoff consume time.
Emergency preemption leaves event/fatigue trace.
Biological rest requirements can vary by species/medical state.
Ship schedule does not force one Human sleep model on every species.
Personality/preferences influence chosen leisure.
Schedule/facility/access state determines what is possible.
Social density changes encounter probability but not relationship state directly.
Cargo, liner, courier, tug, salvage, mining, survey, medical, rescue, colony transport, trader and private roles can use procedural design grammar.
Weapons are absent by default unless legal/operator context supports them.
Smuggling cannot be generated without an actual illegal-market cause.
Seed shipboard_fixture_001 resolves Oberth science vessel.
Duty crew target is 80.
Watch allocation is 28 Alpha + 24 Beta + 24 Gamma + 4 relief.
Stable ship_id is gen:starship:de67f663aaf6de92.
Ship, design, crew, watch assignment and schedules do not reroll on reload.
Off-screen simulation may evolve state through events only.
Destroyed/captured/decommissioned states are outcomes, not regeneration triggers.
AI can explain current duty/off-duty state.
AI cannot create shifts, people, rooms, free time, cargo, authority or availability.
AI cannot teleport an NPC because player initiates conversation.
Engine-generated operational policy is proposal/default, not higher authority.
Player captain can accept, modify, replace or delegate captain-owned decisions.
Accepting the engine proposal unchanged may be recorded as captain_approved.
Player captain may order three, four or custom watches when constraints permit.
XO can be tasked to build the detailed new roster.
Warnings about fatigue/coverage do not silently restore engine preference.
Manual, proposal_requires_approval and delegated_autonomous modes are supported.
Captain can revoke or narrow delegation.
Delegate cannot exercise authority outside declared limits.
Captain cannot create capabilities/resources/qualifications.
Valid medical fitness authority remains protected.
Higher lawful tasking/regulation can constrain discretion.
Non-overrideable safety constraints remain non-overrideable.
Engine may warn against a captain choice.
If lawful and physically possible, the order can execute.
Consequences are simulated and linked to command history.
Every new automated operational decision declares authority owner.
Override/review and delegation policies are explicit.
Engine recommendation score never becomes authority.

runtime_boundary: CoreRPG 4.5+ must eventually own generic live World State, schedule arbitration, persistence and catch-up execution. These invariants define the Star Trek-facing contract.
